title: Rabbi Chilkiyah
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: (A Palestinian Amora, one of the great masters of aggadah.) He was Rabbi Simon’s student, as Hyman notes that he always spoke in Rabbi Simon’s name, as in Jerusalem Talmud Shekalim 1:5, Yevamot 5:2, [Bereshit Rabbah 18:4 (Hyman cites 18:5)](https://www.sefaria.org/Bereshit_Rabbah.18.4) and [Pesikta Rabbati, piska “Anokhi Menachemkhem,”](https://www.sefaria.org/Pesikta_Rabbati.33.1) sections 3, 5 and 9. In [Kiddushin 33b](https://www.sefaria.org/Kiddushin.33b.12): “Rabbi Chilkiyah, Rabbi Simon and Rabbi Elazar say: A fortiori — before those who study it one stands, all the more so before it.”[^1]

Likewise he spoke in Rabbi Acha’s name, as in [Jerusalem Talmud Shekalim 2:3](https://www.sefaria.org/Jerusalem_Talmud_Shekalim.2.3.4). Of those who speak in his name we find Rabbi Avin, in [Aggadat Bereshit, end of chapter 31](https://www.sefaria.org/Aggadat_Bereshit.31.3), with the precious saying: “Foolish is the heart of the liars who say that the Holy One, blessed be He, has a son. If, in the case of Abraham’s son, when He saw that he came to slaughter him, He immediately cried out, ‘Do not lay your hand upon the lad’ — had He had a son, would He have left him, and would He not have overturned the world?” etc.

Rabbi Ashyan in his name: [Aggadat Bereshit, chapter 70](https://www.sefaria.org/Aggadat_Bereshit.70.2). Rabbi Pinchas in his name: [Bereshit Rabbah 53:9](https://www.sefaria.org/Bereshit_Rabbah.53.9).

Rabbi Pinchas HaKohen bar Chama in his name: [Tanchuma, Vayera 37](https://www.sefaria.org/Midrash_Tanchuma_Buber%2C_Vayera.37.5). Hyman suggests that it is likely that he is Rabbi Chilkiyah of the South (as it is known that Rabbi Simon was in the South, in Lod, in the place of his teacher Rabbi Yehoshua ben Levi), and as cited in [Tanchuma, Kedoshim 1](https://www.sefaria.org/Midrash_Tanchuma%2C_Kedoshim.1.1): Rabbi Pinchas in the name of Rabbi Chilkiyah of the South in the name of Rabbi Reuven.[^2]

notes.text: The linked Bereshit Rabbah and Pesikta Rabbati have Chilkiyah speak in Rabbi Simon’s name. Shekalim 2:3 has him speak in Rabbi Acha’s name. Kiddushin names Chilkiyah, Simon and Elazar together.

Aggadat Bereshit names Avin and Ashyan transmitting in Chilkiyah’s name. The linked Vayera names Pinchas HaKohen bar Chama. In the linked Kedoshim, Rabbi Pinchas speaks in the name of Chilkiyah of the South. The consulted text does not give the further Rabbi Reuven attribution in that sentence. Hyman tentatively identifies the two Chilkiyahs.
